svg.text: SUTRA — Workflow & Integration Diagram
Statewide Unified Tracking, Registry & Analytics · Hybrid: Model 1 registry & GIS foundation on a Model 3 federation layer · Gujarat Police CCTV Integration Hackathon 2026
TIER 1 · SOURCES
Heterogeneous cameras
26 departments · analog and IP · many VMS vendors · owners stay owners
Challenge portal — Sentinel Camera Grid
30 live cameras · credentialed RTSP, H.264 + H.265
cookie-authenticated HLS as fallback
Departmental VMS / NVR
RTSP · ONVIF Profile S/T · vendor SDK
each one an adapter module, no core change
Private, society and commercial cameras
RTSP or HTTP · onboarded via API, CSV or UI
same registry, same health model
Recorded footage
file sources for investigation and replay
Source credentials stay in the edge node's environment.
The registry only ever stores credential-free URLs.
video
TIER 2 · EDGE NODE
Ingest and inference, next to the cameras
Commodity CPU server per district or department · FFmpeg + ONNX Runtime · no GPU
SUTRA BRIDGE
Source adapters and adaptive ingest scheduler
One adapter contract: discover · probe · open stream · health
Concurrency budget, dwell rotation, operator pinning, alert-boost of the
hit camera and its neighbours · health reported honestly per camera
SUTRA INSIGHT
AI video analytics
ANPR: YOLOv9-t plate detection → CCT-S OCR → temporal voting →
Indian-plate normalisation and state-code repair · 30–75 ms per frame
Scene analytics: YOLOX-nano person and vehicle counts · evidence crop per read
SUTRA WATCH
Watchlist matching and real-time alerting
Every read is cross-referenced: exact match, or fuzzy (confusion-fold,
edit distance 1) labelled "probable" with the raw characters shown
Alert episodes with cooldown · annotated evidence frame · acknowledgement
Edge → central sync, every 30 s, resumable
Metadata, plate reads, alerts and evidence crops only. Video never leaves the edge.
metadata
TIER 3 · CENTRAL
Command centre, hosted
Registry, alerts, trace, evidence, reports · PostgreSQL · 102 MB, no video
SUTRA ATLAS · MODEL 1 (MANDATORY)
Registry and GIS foundation
Location, department, type, ownership, connectivity,
storage, retention, install date · manual / API / CSV / discovery
Layered GIS map with live health · gap and ageing analysis
Role-based search, CSV export, full metadata audit trail
SUTRA COMMAND
Control-room UI (React + Leaflet)
Video wall relayed once per camera, never fanned out
Real-time alert centre with evidence · watchlist manager
Vehicle Trace: timestamped movement history on the map
Detections browser · output report export (UTC + IST)
GOVERNMENT DATABASE CONNECTORS
VAHAN-shaped connector live today · SARTHI, eGujCop (CCTNS),
AFIS / NAFIS are connector swaps · owner identity masked by role
SECURITY AND AUDITABILITY
JWT + department-scoped RBAC · HttpOnly media tokens · login rate limit
authenticated evidence store · audit log · CI security scans
OPERATIONAL WORKFLOW
From onboarding a camera to tracing a vehicle

g.text: Onboard
Discover the portal catalogue, import CSV,
call the API or add by hand. Every camera
gets a registry row, coordinates, department
and a live health state.
Ingest
The scheduler opens streams within the
budget, RTSP over TCP with credentials
injected at open, and samples about one
frame per second per camera.
Analyse
Plates are detected, read and voted across
frames; scenes are counted for people and
vehicles. Each read keeps its evidence crop
and its confidence.
Correlate and alert
Reads are matched to the watchlist and
enriched from the vehicle database. A hit
raises a real-time alert and boosts the
neighbouring cameras.
Trace and report
Given a registration number, SUTRA
reconstructs the route with timestamps on
the GIS map and exports the output report
with UTC and IST times.

svg.text: Why it scales to ~80,000 cameras

Video stays at the edge and only events travel upward, so central bandwidth and storage grow with the number of events, not the number of streams. Add an edge node per district; the central tier does not change shape.
Everything shown is running code: hosted central tier at sutra-central.onrender.com · edge node on the challenge portal's cameras · 175 automated tests · 31 recorded acceptance checks
github.com/laveshparyani/SUTRA · Team: Lavesh Paryani and Hiral Kotwani · Architecture, sizing and cost model in SUTRA_HLD.pdf
